alpha_use_rules.quarantined_rows: blocked from survey, starter Atlas, default Mission Gen, app surfaces, Apple auto-resolution, OpenAI prompt payloads
alpha_use_rules.context_only_families: blocked from default first mission generation
alpha_use_rules.atlas_promotion_semantics: blocked until Atlas promotion logic owns decision
alpha_use_rules.alpha_candidate_blocklist: blocked from survey display, starter Atlas, default Mission Gen, Supabase active rows, OpenAI prompt payloads, and Apple auto-resolution
alpha_use_rules.music_object_ref: required for app/local candidate and tile payloads; reference-only, never user taste
alpha_use_rules.qa_exception_ledger: preserve warnings/manual-review rows as QA context; blocked rows do not feed product surfaces
alpha_use_rules.compact_candidate_pool: use helper output as curated playback-ready sample material only; default playback sample requires canonical song recordings with resolved Apple Music catalog IDs
alpha_use_rules.apple_music_unmatched_no_id: canonical rows stay in graph but do_not_use_no_apple_id rows are blocked from Alpha playback, playback-route selection, Supabase active playback candidates, OpenAI playback payloads, and Apple auto-resolution
alpha_use_rules.canonical_mission_item_universe: full canonical grid is available as mission material; compact pools are slices/samples, not the universe
alpha_use_rules.canonical_graph_with_apple_id_survey_eli: any canonical graph item with an Apple Music catalog ID is available for Survey consideration unless blocklisted
alpha_use_rules.approved_survey_surfaces: survey_*_candidates_v0_2 are approved/default Alpha surfaces, not the outer limit of Survey eligibility

safe_send_gate.supabase: only passing active playback candidate rows with alpha_v0 contract version and resolved Apple Music catalog IDs for playable tracks
safe_send_gate.openai: compact payloads only: no raw graph dump, no hidden truth, no quarantined rows, no do_not_use_no_apple_id playback rows
